by_judge.judge: P SREE SUDHA IS NOT HOLDING SITTING ON 13.08.2026

narrative:
On August 13, 2026, the Karnataka High Court listed 2,628 cases across 49 judges, conducting hearings in 1,011 matters for an overall hearing rate of 38.5%. This represents a slight decline compared to recent sitting days, which recorded overall hearing rates of 40.2% on August 12 (1,073 of 2,670 cases heard) and 41.2% on August 11 (1,066 of 2,589 cases heard), while remaining comparable to the 39.6% rate observed on August 7.

Individual bench performance varied significantly alongside listing volumes. Efficiency highlights include Justice Shivashankar Amarannavar in Court Hall 20, who heard 66 of 82 scheduled cases (80.5%) in his main list. The division bench of the Chief Justice and Justice K.S. Hemalekha in Court Hall 1 achieved a 69.7% hearing rate (23 of 33 cases heard), while Justice M.I. Arun in Court Hall 15 converted 45 of 65 listed matters (69.2%). Benches managing exceptionally large dockets experienced lower conversion rates, such as Justice S. Vishwajith Shetty in Court Hall 19, who heard 78 of 293 scheduled matters (26.6%).

By procedural stage, Orders matters constituted the largest portion of the docket with 1,036 cases scheduled and 445 heard (43.0% conversion), showing an uptick from the 41.9% conversion rate for Orders on August 12. Admission matters saw 165 of 455 cases heard (36.3%), whereas Final Hearing matters recorded a lower conversion rate of 25.0% (125 of 501 heard).

In terms of case types, Writ Petitions (WP) dominated total volume with 1,116 listings and 394 hearings (35.3%), down from 38.5% on August 12. Miscellaneous First Appeals (MFA) followed with 406 scheduled and 178 heard (43.8%), while Criminal Petitions (CRL.P) recorded a 36.2% clearance rate (114 of 315 heard).
